questions: Are there two distinct low-level switches, one for Tank 1 and one for Tank 2, or one shared low-level switch serving both completion conditions?
What physical connection does each named valve implement?

answers.clar_001_low_level_switch_identity: One shared low-level switch entity senses Tank 1 during transfer completion and Tank 2 during draining completion.
answers.clar_002_valve_routing: Define explicit physical endpoints for each valve only after clarification from source material.
